description: This PHP file defines the Product model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin catalog module. It includes methods for adding, editing, copying, deleting, and retrieving product data, as well as managing related entities such as descriptions, categories, attributes, options, filters, and SEO URLs. The class directly interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations on product-related tables.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents the product entity in the OpenCart admin catalog module, providing methods for CRUD operations and management of product-related data in the database.
